description: This file is a PHP class defining a controller for managing order status localizations in an OpenCart administration module, including listing, form handling, saving, and deleting order statuses.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Controller class for managing order status localization in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the order status page with headers, breadcrumbs, and data list.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to list order statuses.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the list of order statuses, including pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing an order status, including language descriptions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving or updating an order status, with permission checks and validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected order statuses after permission and dependency checks.
